blockers: R30: births, precursor warp policy, saved lifecycle, whole-hull throat loss and work ledger are not wired in this baseline.
R31/R32: optical funnels and acquired field geometry/response are not mounted/produced. Packet counts do not certify precursor coverage.
3E clearance covers bodies/asteroids only: its wholeFlightSweptMinimumMeters is NOT all-funnel clearance.
Continuous late arrivals, both branch orders, cross-transfer and carried-rule comparison need the retained owners' integration.

result.knowledge: [ASSUMED] Author-supplied inertial direction from S22 geometry; no acquired funnel rule or player inference is claimed. The nominal +/-y controls port S22's 16 s, 24 kN burn at t=600 through actual main propulsion, with a real roll-held direction command 480 s beforehand and rate nulling 5 s after cutoff. Navigator stand-in only; forecasts are not fitted-model evidence.

acquisitionSchedule.modelClock: deterministic 300x: 300 simulation seconds per 1000 logical wall milliseconds; production handover/refit intervals unchanged

swept.method: Production segmentHull on body-frame endpoint chords, using production midpoint COM and end-of-tick hull. A conservative hull bounding-sphere test culls segments that cannot improve the retained minimum. Spheres are bodies/asteroids; local fields and apertures need their authored evaluators.
swept.limitation: This measures the production fixed-tick geometry approximation, requiring |omega|*dt << 1, not an exact continuous trajectory. End-hull geometry is held fixed during each tick as in production, so sub-tick appendage motion is not certified. Contact-relocated or missing/new/radius-changing object endpoints make full coverage incomplete; authoritative impacts still report zero. Missing absorbed-object trajectories require TickResult to expose the original Simulation.minClearance/absorbed result. A negative bounding-sphere bound alone is not a collision.

clearance.limitation: Pass-event figures can omit receding and unfinished far passes and use CoM distance beyond 5000 m. The separate swept report evaluates every available endpoint pair with production hull geometry and documents incomplete coverage and fixed-tick limits.

resources.ledgerUnits: min/max/final are W; integral is J. sampledSeconds states coverage. Missing keys mean unavailable, never zero.

control.limitation: Rates, delivered/unserved impulses and component condition are diagnostics. They do not establish remaining directional control authority or roll-held reachability; those require an authored maneuver and acceptance envelope.

observations.limitation: Counts and acquisition gaps are from recorded production packets. Packet counts do not prove spatial coverage; unseen targets and fields are unresolved. Forecast horizon belongs to the separate real-model result.

limits: A finite survival window is not encounter completion.
No route or condition fixture is a human playtest.
No forecast receives these truth-side metrics.

budgetTargets.scope: Measured consumption only; incomplete flights do not pass route admission.
